input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement has no post-termination transition assistance or data-return obligation. Section 13 only makes Client responsible for arranging a new name server within 30 days and a new hosting environment within 60 days (and confirms Client's ownership of domains and Client Content), and Section 14 merely runs services to month-end after notice. Section 10 (Confidentiality) contains no return or destruction mechanic at all. Nothing obliges TrueLink, which hosts the Web Site and holds Client borrower and loan data, to return that data in usable form, assist migration, or certify deletion — below even the fallback (90 days' assistance plus export within 30 days). We propose inserting the preferred language (6 months' assistance at then-current rates, 30-day machine-readable return, certified deletion thereafter) as a new Section 14a, with a 90-day assistance period available as a fallback.

ops.text: TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND RETURN OF CLIENT DATA. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide reasonable transition assistance, including reasonable migration support for the Web Site and Hosting Services, for up to six (6) months at TrueLink's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Client's request, return to Client all Client Content and other Client data in TrueLink's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Client Content and Client data from its systems and certify such deletion to Client in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit provision: TrueLink returns our Client Content and data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, provides up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, and certifies deletion afterwards. As TrueLink hosts our site and holds our borrower and loan data, the current termination terms leave us responsible for re-hosting with no right to get our data back; we can discuss a 90-day assistance period if six months is not workable.
proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance, data return within 30 days, and certified deletion into Section 14 (Termination).
